It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, lists property owners, and provides details about land extents, encumbrances, and mortgages. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
